description:
SIGN THE PETITION👇 End the 40 year reign of terror. Restore accountability and legal liability to vaccine manufacturers. www.vacsafety.org/petitionShow more This week marks an exciting new chapter for VSRF Live as we officially move to our new night—Tuesday at 7 PM Eastern—and we’re honored to welcome back a guest whose voice has helped shape some of the most important conversations of the past several years. Joining us is Dr. Robert Malone, a physician and scientist widely recognized for his depth of knowledge, independent thinking, and willingness to engage with some of the most complex and consequential issues in modern medicine and public policy. We’re truly grateful to have him return for what promises to be a powerful and thought-provoking discussion.
In this episode, Dr. Malone will guide us through the highly complex and often controversial world of gain-of-function research and the global network of biolabs. With his unique perspective and ability to connect scientific, regulatory, and geopolitical dots, he will help unpack what these programs are designed to do, how they are funded, and why they continue to raise urgent questions around safety, oversight, and accountability.
We’ll also explore developments within federal health agencies, including the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) and the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). Drawing on his experience and insight, Dr. Malone will share his perspective on how key decisions are being shaped behind the scenes, who holds influence, and what these dynamics may mean for the future of public health policy and institutional trust.
This conversation comes at a moment when many are asking deeper questions about how science, policy, and power intersect—and few are as equipped as Dr. Malone to help navigate that terrain. Join us Tuesday night as we dive into these critical issues together. Show less
